entities.name: UE-initiated NAS transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE sends UL NAS TRANSPORT message to AMF in connected mode to transport various payload types including PDU session information, SMS, LPP messages, SOR transparent container, UE policy container, UE parameters update, location services, CIoT user data, Service-level-AA container, or multiple payloads.

entities.name: UL NAS TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink NAS transport message sent by UE to AMF to carry various payload types.

entities.name: Payload container type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of payload being transported, with values including N1 SM information, SMS, LPP message container, SOR transparent container, UE policy container, UE parameters update transparent container, Location services message container, CIoT user data container, Service-level-AA container, or Multiple payloads.

entities.name: Payload container IE
entities.description: Information element containing the actual payload data being transported, with contents depending on the payload container type.

entities.name: PDU session information
entities.description: Collection of IEs including PDU session ID, old PDU session ID, S-NSSAI, mapped S-NSSAI, DNN, and request type for PDU session related transport.

entities.name: Additional information IE
entities.description: Optional IE containing routing information for location services and LPP message transport.

entities.name: MA PDU session information IE
entities.description: Information element for multi-access PDU session information, included only with PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST and PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST messages.

entities.name: Connected mode
entities.description: UE must be in connected mode to initiate NAS transport procedure.

entities.name: SMS over NAS access selection
entities.description: UE behavior for selecting 3GPP or non-3GPP access for SMS over NAS transmission based on UE preferences and availability.

relations.description: NAS transport procedure involves sending UL NAS TRANSPORT message

UL NAS TRANSPORT message contains Payload container type IE
